channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX-Tesla mega merger could be announced in December: What could derail the deal?
item.description: SpaceX and Tesla are advancing merger talks, with an announcement potentially coming as early as December. The proposed deal could create the world's biggest corporate combination, but regulatory hurdles, Tesla's China operations and US national security concerns could complicate the transaction.

item.title: Nvidia’s leadership vacuum: Can Colette Kress protect its AI dominance after Jensen Huang’s exit? Expert decodes
item.description: Nvidia faces uncertainty after co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned following revelations of two extramarital affairs. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO as the board searches for a successor.&nbsp;

item.title: Alice Huang linked to Huawei? What we know about Jensen Huang's lover's ties to Nvidia's Chinese rival
item.description: Alice Huang, described as Jensen Huang's 'lover', was indirectly linked to a data centre in China whose key customer was Huawei, Nvidia's biggest rival in the country. Her business connections have raised questions about potential US scrutiny, though no wrongdoing has been established.

item.title: Microsoft outage drags on for five hours, disrupting Outlook, Teams and Copilot for thousands across US
item.description: Microsoft faced a major outage on Thursday, disrupting access to Outlook, Teams and Copilot for several hours. The disruption also affected connectors used by OpenAI and Anthropic, while the company worked to restore affected servers and gradually bring services back online.

item.title: Blackstone emerges frontrunner to buy Actis-owned BluPine at $1.8 billion valuation
item.description: For Blackstone, the acquisition deal for BluPine Energy, comes at a time when it has stepped up efforts to build a large infrastructure portfolio in India.

item.title: Canada threatens to sue Stellantis over auto plant sale as Trump’s trade war shifts production south
item.description: Canada threatens to sue Stellantis over auto plant sale as Trump’s trade war shifts production south

item.title: Who would be next CEO at Nvidia? Top engineer and CFO favored as candidates
item.description: NVIDIA-CEO-REPLACEMENTS:Who would be next CEO at Nvidia? Top engineer and CFO favored as candidates

item.title: Banco BPM to Review Credit Agricole Bid, Seeks ‘Adequate Value’
item.description: Banco BPM SpA said it will review Credit Agricole SA’s proposal to combine their Italian banking operations, and said it will seek “adequate value” for shareholders.

item.title: IBM to end H-1B visa and green card sponsorship for most consulting roles amid Trump's immigration crackdown — Report
item.description: The development comes amid increased scrutiny of employment-based immigration programmes under the Trump administration, particularly the H-1B visa programme, which allows US employers to hire skilled foreign professionals in specialised occupations.

item.title: Alice Huang’s China links: Firms related to her promised Nvidia Blackwell chips to DeepSeek despite US ban, report says
item.description: Companies linked to Alice Huang have reportedly invested in DeepSeek and promised to supply it with Nvidia's advanced Blackwell processors. The reported arrangement has raised questions about US export restrictions, although it remains unclear whether the chips have been delivered.

item.title: Nvidia next CEO: Who’s Jay Puri? Harvard alumnus Indian-origin techie grad to succeed Jensen Huang? Strongest candidate
item.description: Amid the high-stakes leadership shuffle, several names have emerged as frontrunners, including Indian-origin Jay Puri, who is being considered a strong candidate.

item.title: ‘Extraordinarily difficult period’: Nvidia's new CEO Kress reassures staff after Jensen Huang's exit | Read full email
item.description: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress has reassured employees after Jensen Huang's exit, calling it an ‘extraordinarily difficult period’. In her first email, she thanked staff for their resilience, expressed confidence in the company's future and urged them to move forward together.

item.title: Chinese traders stay confident of Nvidia GPU supply despite Jensen Huang scandal as prices ease
item.description: Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang had resigned as president, chief executive and board member with immediate effect after the board accepted his resignation. The Chinese traders’ calm view of supply, sits against this sudden leadership change at the world’s leading AI chip maker.

item.title: The Sunil Mittal interview: Airtel debt-free by 2029. Buybacks next?
item.description: After 50 years of building businesses, Sunil Bharti Mittal expects Airtel to be debt-free by 2029. With the balance sheet getting stronger, could share buybacks be the telecom giant's next big move? Mittal also discusses AI, data centres and the next phase of growth.

item.title: Maharashtra couple earns up to ₹50 lakh revenue growing saffron without soil in a 400 sq ft room, here's how they did it
item.description: A couple from Nagpur in Maharashtra began their saffron-growing business by investing around ₹55 lakh. They bought around 100 saffron bulbs from Kashmir and planted them in their house. Here's what happened next.

item.title: Jensen Huang resigns: From extramarital affairs to China links, how the Nvidia controversy unfolded | Timeline
item.description: The company's official statement doesn't mention the reason for Jensen's resignation. However, under Nvidia's bylaws, Huang can be removed 'with or without cause' by a majority vote of the directors, Reuters reported earlier.

item.title: Kaju Katli, Diet Coke, Gold Coins: What India ordered during last minute Diwali 2026 preparation from Swiggy InstaMart
item.description: This Diwali, Indians turned to the quick commerce platform for last-minute festive preparations. Their purchases included gold, silver and sweets while also ordering party supplies and gifting items.

item.title: Nvidia turns to CFO Colette Kress to steady ship after Jensen Huang exit
item.description: In naming Colette Kress as interim CEO, Nvidia is making a classic move for a company in crisis.

item.title: Jensen Huang resigns: Meet the Nvidia board members who decided his fate after affair reports
item.description: The Nvidia Corp. board of directors who met to decide Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s fate ahead of his ouster on Thursday have a range of backgrounds, from running Taco Bell’s international operations to academic research involving a jellyfish.

item.title: Who is Harvey C Jones? NVIDIA appoints first-ever board chair as Jensen Huang resigns from board, CEO post
item.description: NVIDIA appointed longtime board member Harvey C. Jones as its first board chair, while announcing that CEO Jensen Huang would step down and CFO Colette Kress would serve as interim CEO. The company said it would seek a permanent CEO from internal and external candidates.

item.title: ReNew, CleanMax announce investments totalling ₹1.3 trillion into data centres, green energy space in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: ReNew commits ₹80,000 crore for a green data centre and solar component plants, while CleanMax plans ₹50,000 crore in clean energy to power an AI compute hub.

item.title: Vodafone Idea’s Q2 performance misses expectations
item.description: &nbsp;Vodafone Idea’s net loss widened to ₹5,975 crore in Q2 from ₹5,562 crore a year ago, missing Bloomberg's estimate of ₹5,263 crore, even as it arranged over ₹4,000 crore in incremental bank funding during the quarter.

item.title: Who is Colette Kress? From Microsoft and Cisco to Nvidia's interim CEO after Huang's resignation — her career, education
item.description: Kress will continue to serve as Nvidia's executive vice president and CFO alongside her interim CEO responsibilities until a permanent replacement is appointed.

item.title: Jensen Huang, face of the AI boom, ousted as Nvidia CEO after multiple affairs
item.description: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Harvey Jones, who previously led Synopsys, has been named chairman.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns, tech giant appoints Colette Kress as Interim CEO
item.description: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang has stepped down as CEO, president and board member amid reports of alleged extramarital affairs, including one with a businesswoman suspected by US authorities of ties to Chinese intelligence. Details here.

item.title: Ola Electric struggles to stem declining revenue, worsening unit economics
item.description: Ola Electric's revenue falls 39% year-on-year to ₹421 crore in the September quarter, while adjusted Ebitda margins worsened to -58.5%, despite a narrowing of losses to ₹362 crore.

item.title: Could Jensen Huang exit Nvidia? Board reportedly works with outside firm to identify potential replacements
item.description: Nvidia board is also reportedly considering the possibility of appointing an interim chief executive while searching for a permanent replacement.

item.title: Do Nvidia bylaws allow its board to remove Jensen Huang amid China spy controversy? Here's what we know
item.description: Nvidia's bylaws allow its board to remove CEO Jensen Huang at any time, with or without cause, through a majority vote of directors. However, removing him as CEO would not automatically cost him his board seat, which requires a separate shareholder vote under different rules.

item.title: Zee Entertainment announces ₹600 crore buyback at 24% premium
item.description: The buyback comes as Zee seeks to restore investor confidence amid concerns over advertising growth, profitability and rising content investments.

item.title: Adani's Kutch Copper signs MoU with Chile's Codelco for copper exploration: What does the deal involve?
item.description: Adani Group’s Kutch Copper and Chile’s Codelco have agreed to assess Kaburkaala copper project in northern Chile. The pact could link Chilean deposits with Mundra smelter, supporting long-term copper supplies for India, prioritising sustainable exploration, safety and environmental compliance.

item.title: Bodhi Tree Systems invests $180 mn for majority stake in Chennai’s Adyar Ananda Bhavan
item.description: Investment platform Bodhi Tree Systems has bought a majority stake in Chennai-based Adyar Ananda Bhavan for $180 million. A2B operates 160 outlets in India and more than 30 overseas.

item.title: Foxconn forecasts ‘double-digit’ 2027 revenue growth; Chairman Young Liu says ‘AI will be most important growth driver’
item.description: Hon Hai, also know as Foxconn, expects double-digit revenue growth in 2027, citing strong demand for AI servers and networking equipment. Chairman Young Liu called AI the company’s biggest growth engine.&nbsp;

item.title: Indo-German JV Benecore bets ₹200 crore on making diaper, sanitary napkin material in India
item.description: The German-Indian joint venture expects ₹300 crore revenue from its new Bhopal plant and plans to double capacity by 2029 as it looks to replace imports, particularly from China.

item.title: Tata Steel targets 10 million tonnes of domestic iron ore sales this year as captive curbs ease
item.description: The steelmaker is monetizing surplus mining capacity while testing imported ore blends ahead of 2030 mine expirations and targeting up to ₹10,000 crore in annual India cost savings.

item.title: Norwest's $4 billion fund to back India's manufacturing, healthcare, AI
item.description: Norwest Venture Partners plans to invest $250–300 million annually in India, targeting manufacturing, healthcare, pharma, financial services, consumer businesses, AI and deeptech&nbsp;
